references.text: Moses exhorts the people not to fear the Egyptians and reminds them that the Lord will fight for them—a direct parallel to the reminder of God's mighty acts against Pharaoh and Egypt.
Moses tells the people not to fear their enemies, for the Lord your God will fight for them, just as he did in Egypt.
The continuation of the text elaborating on what the people should remember: the great trials, signs, and wonders that the Lord performed in Egypt.
A reminder of the Lord's signs and acts against Pharaoh and his army, when he caused the waters of the Red Sea to overwhelm them.
An exhortation not to fear the enemy in war, for the Lord who brought them out of Egypt is with them.
Description of God's mighty acts against Pharaoh and Egypt, with signs and wonders.
An exhortation not to fear the people in the land, for the Lord is with Israel.
The Lord commands Joshua to be strong and courageous, not to fear, for the Lord is with him.
The Lord's words about not fearing, for he is with his people and will strengthen them.
Encouragement not to fear humans, for the Lord is our helper.
